steps.message:
I have fixed the issue where inline table code styles were being lost. In `rich/markdown.py`, I modified `TableDataElement.on_text` to use `self.content.append(text)` instead of `self.content.append_text(text)`. This ensures that if `text` is already a `Text` object (which happens for inline code), its internal styles are preserved when added to the table cell content.

Test to run: `tests/test_markdown.py`
